source: hand-derived G36 sequence reference from fixture topology plus CDL / Buildings .mo semantics, independent of oce-blocks; this signal follows a fixed-step discretization shared with the engine and is frame-rate dependent (see frame_rate_dependence), not an independent continuous-time re-derivation
compare_regime: exact G36 Tier-A sequence f64 trace (Value::bit_eq)
input: ReturnFanDirectPressure fan-speed path: supply-fan switch plus parent-default disSpe_min=0.1 and disSpe_max=1
reference_rule: Pinned source plus parent Controller defaults: yRetFan = Switch(Line(dpDisSetPre, x1=2.4, f1=0.1, x2=40, f2=1), u1SupFan, 0)
frame_rate_dependence: frame-rate dependent: this signal is a Line of the ReturnFanDirectPressure.mo conP PI loop (k=1, Ti=0.5 s), integrated by forward Euler at the 1 s frame step, applied after each frame's output: xI += (k/Ti)*(e-(yU-y)/(k*Ni))*dt with dt=1 s, so k*dt/Ti=2 and each frame's integral step is twice the error. The values change with the frame step. The engine uses the same forward-Euler recurrence, so this column checks that shared discretization, not an independent continuous-time derivation of ReturnFanDirectPressure.mo
format: Modelica CombiTimeTable CSV (_spec/07 §9); signal CSV is time+one output; reference.csv is time+inputs+all outputs; ryu shortest-round-trip f64
